svg.title: svrngs: your group’s things, on your group’s computers
svg.desc: A link in a chat lets a person in from a phone or a computer in seconds. The group’s record lives on every member’s computer, with no server; a relay carries sealed bytes for phones. You stand at the center of your own rings, and nothing ranks a person. We host a page, a download and a relay, each replaceable, none holding the group’s things.
svg.text: Your group’s things, on your group’s computers.
The money you split, the nights you plan, the films you own. No accounts, no passwords, no landlord.
